import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
D = 48
HEADS = 4
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class AttnBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 2 * d), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(2 * d, d))

    def forward(self, t):
        b, n, d = t.shape
        hd = d // self.heads
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(t)).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(b, n, self.heads, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.reshape(b, n, self.heads, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(b, n, self.heads, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, n, d)
        t = t + self.o(y)
        t = t + self.ff(self.ln2(t))
        return t


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, D, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 3, padding=1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, spec.Y * spec.X, D) * 0.02)
        self.blk = AttnBlock(D, HEADS)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b, _, yy, xx = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(s + self.c1(s))
        t = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        t = self.blk(t)
        f = F.relu(t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, -1, yy, xx))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.hypothesis: Change: a learned column MLP splits into Z per-layer feature maps. Shared 3x3 convs and a cross-layer 1x1 mix follow, then footprint max, min and mean pooling for each layer, then a logsumexp over layers. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

HID = 64
K = 16
P = 16
H = 16

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.0015, "gamma": 0.97}


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, HID, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(HID, HID, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.tolayer = nn.Conv2d(HID, self.Z * K, 1)
        self.sp1 = nn.Conv2d(K, K, 3, padding=1)
        self.mixz = nn.Conv2d(self.Z * K, self.Z * K, 1)
        self.sp2 = nn.Conv2d(K, K, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(K, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * HID + 2 * K, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b, _, yy, xx = obs.shape
        z = self.Z
        c = self.col(obs)
        l = F.relu(self.tolayer(c))
        l = l.reshape(b * z, K, yy, xx)
        l = F.relu(l + self.sp1(l))
        l = l.reshape(b, z * K, yy, xx)
        l = F.relu(l + self.mixz(l))
        l = l.reshape(b * z, K, yy, xx)
        l = F.relu(l + self.sp2(l))
        p = self.proj(l)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1).reshape(b, z, len(self.fps), yy, xx)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1).flatten(1)
        l5 = l.reshape(b, z, K, yy, xx)
        g_in = torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3)), l5.mean((1, 3, 4)), l5.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(g_in)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
K = 16

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.0015, "gamma": 0.97}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


def all_views(p, square):
    v = [p, p.flip(2), p.flip(3), p.flip(2, 3)]
    if square:
        v = v + [t.transpose(2, 3) for t in v]
    return torch.cat(v, dim=1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.square = int(spec.Y) == int(spec.X)
        nv = 8 if self.square else 4
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.pre = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, K, 1)
        self.post = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(nv * K, HID, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(HID, int(spec.n_types), 1))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
K = 16
FC_C = 8

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.0015, "gamma": 0.97}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


def all_views(p, square):
    v = [p, p.flip(2), p.flip(3), p.flip(2, 3)]
    if square:
        v = v + [t.transpose(2, 3) for t in v]
    return torch.cat(v, dim=1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.square = self.Y == self.X
        nv = 8 if self.square else 4
        cells = self.Y * self.X
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(int(spec.in_channels) + self.nt, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.pre = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, K, 1)
        self.post = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(nv * K, HID, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(HID, self.nt, 1))
        self.fcp = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, FC_C, 1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(FC_C * cells, self.n_place)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(b, self.nt, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c3(x))
        v = all_views(F.relu(self.pre(f)), self.square)
        place = self.head(f) + self.post(v).flatten(1) + self.fc(F.relu(self.fcp(f)).flatten(1))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting network scored 0.000 on both seeds. With the default recipe it gets only 131,072 / 4,096 = 32 PPO updates, and the learning rate decays to zero across them. That is very few for a 257-way action space where every placement has to be right. The network design looks capable of the core judgement. Its 1x1 stem sees each whole column, so it can learn which layers are missing and the column heights. Max and min pooling over each footprint can then tell where a brick lands and whether every cell there is a missing target cell. So my first guess is that the recipe is the bottleneck: too few updates and too few samples. Round 1 tests two recipe settings on the unchanged network (2 epochs on smaller batches, and 1 epoch with the most samples). The third candidate adds global attention for choosing the build order, such as building overhangs before the cells that would block them. It is paired with the first recipe so the two results can be compared directly.
analyses.2: Three runs all scored 0 on dev and on training success, so they tell us almost nothing. More samples (407k steps), more updates and an attention block did not help. This points to a problem with what the network can perceive, not with the update count. The hard part of each placement is the landing rule: a brick lands at the highest build height under its footprint, and the move is right only if the target is missing a cell at that layer in every footprint cell. The 2D baseline mixes all layers into one feature map before pooling over the footprint, so it has to reconstruct the landing layer in one shot. My next step is a column-to-layer network: a learned per-column MLP produces features for each layer, then spatial convs, then footprint max, min and mean pooling for each layer, and finally a logsumexp over layers. I'm also testing a recipe change on the baseline (less entropy, longer credit horizon) to check whether learning the end bonus is the bottleneck.
analyses.3: All 6 trials score exactly 0, on dev and also in training (train_success_last10pct = 0). That held across 1 to 2 epochs, 167k to 407k steps, different gamma and entropy settings, attention, and a per-layer head. Seed noise cannot explain a floor this flat, and tuning the recipe has not moved it. Even 90% per-step accuracy would give some exact builds, so something structural is probably wrong. The note says the world may differ from its description. A likely cause is a mismatch between the frame of the obs and the frame of the action index: a transposed or flipped grid, a different anchor corner, or reordered types. Conv and pool heads are tied to their own frame and cannot learn a transpose or a flip, so they would be stuck at 0 even with good features. This round tests heads that can learn the frame. All three keep the r1c3 recipe (1 epoch, most samples) so the results can be compared.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored 0 on dev, and training success was also 0. That held across recipes (1, 2 and 4 epochs; gamma 0.95 to 0.99; entropy 0.002 to 0.01), per-layer heads, attention, dihedral and fully connected heads that ignore the action frame, and mask input. So a mismatch between the obs frame and the action frame is unlikely to be the cause. A sound guess is that training collapses early. Random placements mostly fill cells outside the target, so they earn negative reward. DONE earns 0, so PPO may learn to quit at once or to make safe, timid moves before it finds the placement rule. The remaining bets aim at early-stage dynamics: stronger and longer exploration, standard PPO initialisation (an almost uniform starting policy and a well-scaled critic), and a separate critic so value learning does not distort the policy features.
